QuestInfo.name: Beginner's Luck
QuestInfo.0: Now that you've treated your wounds, you should talk to #bGen#k.
QuestInfo.2: The #bPapyrus Brothers#k are looking for help with a mission. You should speak with them.

0.0: Looks like you're back in fighting shape. And what a coincidence, I've got one for you.
0.1: Pappy and Russ just got back, and until you've proven yourself, you're going to do exactly as they say.\r\nWell? What are you standing around for? Go find them! You can't miss 'em.

0.msg: Finally, my first mission... Now that I'm a Shadowdealer, it's time to show Grandis I'm one to be feared!\r\n

1.msg: Slow down rookie, you're still at the bottom rung of this here ladder. We're starting you off in the little leagues. That means small, local missions.\r\n

3.msg: Show us you can handle the little stuff, then we'll think about trusting you with a bigger mission. Who knows, maybe some day we'll let you leave this rock and see the rest of Grandis?\r\n

4.msg: Until then, keep your mouth shut and stay out of trouble. If you get into any more petty fights, I'm not teaching you anything. Got it?

6.msg: I'll be leaving in a few hours for a mission of my own, so run along and find the Papyrus Brothers. If I were you, I'd use this time to make friends with your fellow branch members.

no.0: What, do you have somewhere better to be?\r\n

0.msg: So, I hear today's the day you take on your first mission! I'm Pappy, and this is my brother Russ. It's real easy to remember. I've got brown horns, and Russ's are black. Get us confused, and you and these horns are gonna get #ereal#n close.\r\n
We'll pick a mission appropriate for a pipsqueak like you. Give us a little time to think it over and then talk to us again.\r\n

default.0: Now that Pappy and Russ are back, they'll be handing out your missions for the time being.\r\nWell? What are you standing around for? Go find them! You can't miss 'em.
